text_block_list.text:
With summer camp nearing its end,
I was looking for Nice Nature when—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: Were you looking at the sea?
Were you looking at the sea?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It'll be the last time seeing it for a while, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
While we're at it,
maybe look back on various things.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I really did get stronger, right?
Compared to before summer camp, I mean."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, the ocean really brings out the sentimental side in you.
Truly a classic youth hotspot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, guess it's time to head home.
I'm finally mentally prepared now, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Ready to take on the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
And so, the summer training camp with Nice Nature came to an end.
